data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Raushan' meaning 'soft, gentle, and happy'. This name is often given to girls who are expected to possess these qualities. The name Raushani carries the meaning “Soft, gentle, and happy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Raushani usually hope their child will grow to embody soft, gentle, and happy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
